title: An Lp(a) check answer whose onCorrect rejects leaves every answer button disabled until the page reloads
evidence: From PR 1772's review (adversary N2); on main before PR 1772 too, where setSaving(true) ran before the await and setSaving(false) after it. LpaChecks sends correcting, then awaits onCorrect (widget-src/src/components/LpaChecks.tsx:82) and sends settled only after it resolves (:90). A rejection skips settled, so the machine stays in saving and the buttons stay disabled (:117, :120). The page's onCorrect (countedCorrection, widget-src/src/hooks/useLongitudinalSave.ts:22) resolves a status and does not catch: only a throw inside the store's correctValue would reject it. Not seen. Remedy if it matters: catch the rejection in answer() and send settled with 'error', with a test.
